title: Leibniz bound for iterated derivatives of a scalar function times a vector-valued function on ℝ^Q
statement: Let Q ∈ ℕ and let F be a real normed space (F : Type with NormedAddCommGroup F and NormedSpace ℝ F). Let f : ℝ^Q → ℝ and g : ℝ^Q → F be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ⊤). Write D^m = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m, with ‖·‖ the operator norm of continuous multilinear maps. Then for every k ∈ ℕ and x ∈ ℝ^Q: ‖D^k(y ↦ f(y)·g(y))(x)‖ ≤ Σ_{i=0}^{k} C(k, i)·‖D^i f(x)‖·‖D^{k−i} g(x)‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : Euclid Q → ℝ) (g : Euclid Q → F), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Euclid Q), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f y • g y) x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g x‖
